messages.subject: For David Cataford | Sustainability, stakeholder strategy and high-purity iron growth
messages.body:
Dear Champion Iron Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. David Cataford, Chief Executive Officer.

Champion Iron's high-purity iron strategy and international growth agenda bring sustainability, community partnerships, government relationships and industrial decarbonisation into the core of long-term value creation. Those priorities align strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My scope combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Champion Iron's sustainability, government-relations, stakeholder or strategic-growth priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Champion Iron.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
